versions.note: First Rain: a six-minute match scored in five stars
Goals with pay, links to the other worlds, a frame-rate report in the pause screen
Echo (replay your last seconds beside you), Dreamwalk (a self-playing tour of every hidden system), Anna painted
Each view is drawn its own way: ink, origami, bedtime book, zine neon, lantern, ledger, wet glass
Paper heroes: Dora is a painted cutout. Keys shown on screen for keyboard play
Ever Fallen mode, Lean Back, Rainwake and Memory views, the Cabinet of easter eggs with the concept plates

Views become a mechanic: rare big fruit exists only through one view; a mood before each red rain is answered by the right view. Known bug: can freeze 30 s before a red rain if the mood lands on the view worn
Fruit power-ups: lemon, rose hips, Verde Limón little and big
Inkblot Noir look (press I), red-rain warning, visible bullets and orbs, louder theft and slam
Cobalt Snow from the concept plate, with the invisible-bullet fix
The Hush as its own side. Known bug: bullets, soul orbs and health-bar fills do not draw
The fold. Mirror teams. Same known bug

notKept: 0.1 to 0.3 exist only as Claude artifact versions and 0.6 was replaced by 0.6.1
